v.2: —there is no denying that it will befall—
v.4: When the earth is shaken violently,
v.5: and the mountains are shattered into bits
v.8: The People of the Right Hand—and what are the People of the Right Hand?!
v.9: And the People of the Left Hand—and what are the People of the Left Hand?!
v.10: And the Foremost Ones are the foremost ones:
v.11: they are the ones brought near [to Allah],
v.12: [who will reside] in the gardens of bliss.
v.14: and a few from the latter ones.
v.16: reclining on them, face to face.
v.17: They will be waited upon by immortal youths,
v.18: with goblets and ewers and a cup of a clear wine,
v.19: which causes them neither headache nor stupefaction,
v.20: and such fruits as they prefer
v.21: and such flesh of fowls as they desire,
v.24: a reward for what they used to do.
v.25: They will not hear therein any vain talk or sinful speech,
v.27: And the People of the Right Hand—what are the People of the Right Hand?!
v.35: We have created them with a special creation,
v.38: for the People of the Right Hand.
v.40: and a multitude from the latter [ones].
v.41: And the People of the Left Hand—what are the People of the Left Hand?!
v.42: Amid infernal miasma and boiling water
v.43: and the shadow of a dense black smoke,
v.45: Indeed they had been affluent before this,
v.46: and they used to persist in the great sin.
v.47: And they used to say, ‘What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?!
v.49: Say, ‘Indeed the former and latter generations
v.50: will all be gathered for the tryst of a known day.
v.52: will surely eat from the Zaqqum tree
v.53: and stuff your bellies with it,
v.54: and drink boiling water on top of it,
v.56: Such will be the hospitality they receive on the Day of Retribution.
v.57: We created you. Then why do you not acknowledge it?
v.58: Have you considered the sperm that you emit?
v.59: Is it you who create it, or are We the creator?
v.60: We have ordained death among you, and We are not to be outmaneuvered
v.61: from replacing you with your likes and recreating you in [a realm] you do not know.
v.62: Certainly you have known the first genesis, then why do you not take admonition?
v.63: Have you considered what you sow?
v.64: Is it you who make it grow, or are We the grower?
v.65: If We wish, We turn it into chaff, whereat you are left stunned [saying to yourselves,]
v.68: Have you considered the water that you drink?
v.69: Is it you who bring it down from the rain cloud, or is it We who bring [it] down?
v.70: If We wish We can make it bitter. Then why do you not give thanks?
v.71: Have you considered the fire that you kindle?
v.72: Was it you who caused its tree to grow, or were We the grower?
v.73: It was We who made it a reminder and a boon for the desert-dwellers.
v.74: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme.
v.75: I swear by the places where the stars set!
v.76: And indeed it is a great oath, should you know.
v.77: This is indeed a noble Quran,
v.79: —no one touches it except the pure ones—
v.80: sent down gradually from the Lord of all the worlds.
v.81: What! Do you take lightly this discourse?
v.82: And make your denial of it your vocation?
v.83: So when it reaches the throat [of the dying person],
v.84: and at that moment you are looking on [at his bedside]
v.85: —and We are nearer to him than you are, though you do not perceive—
v.86: then why do you not restore it, if you are not subject
v.87: [to Divine dispensation], if you are truthful?
v.88: Then, if he be of those brought near,
v.89: then ease, abundance, and a garden of bliss.
v.90: And if he be of the People of the Right Hand,
v.91: then [he will be told,] ‘Peace be on you, from the People of the Right Hand!’
v.92: But if he be of the impugners, the astray ones,
v.93: then a treat of boiling water
v.96: So celebrate the Name of your Lord, the All-supreme!
